newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama public workers strike over pension reform.
newsitem.headline: Panama public workers strike over pension reform.

text.p: Panamanian University teachers, nurses and postmen began an indefinite strike Tuesday in protest over proposed public sector pension reforms, currently awaiting second discussion in congress.

Nurses union representative Diny de Gomez said some 4,000 workers joined the protest, which has left only hospital emergency wards attended. Firemen and employees at the public prosecutors office also picketed throughout the city.
The strike followed a march by nurses, firemen and teachers to congress on Monday that ended in scuffles with congressional security.
The government, which is aiming to move Panama towards Chilean-style private pensions, has said without the reforms the state's pension system will be nearly $4 billion in the red by the year 2025.
